screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authenticate user via email/password or Google OAuth.

components.description: Centered auth card with DocFoundry branding.

props.children: Forge any document into clean, usable data.
Don’t have an account? Start free trial
props.className: mt-4 block text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary

interactions.action: Trigger Google OAuth flow; on success set JWT cookie and redirect to /app.
POST /api/auth/login; on success store JWT cookie, fetch /api/auth/me, redirect to last workspace route (/app). On error, show shadcn/AlertDestructive.
Navigate to /register.

screens.name: Register
screens.purpose: User registration and initial company creation.

components.description: Similar to login, with extra fields.

props.children: Create your account and first company.
Already have an account? Sign in
props.className: mt-4 block text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary

interactions.action: Trigger Google OAuth registration; on success create workspace and redirect to /app/onboarding.
POST /api/auth/register with full_name, email, password, workspace_name; set JWT cookie; redirect to /app/onboarding for first-time setup.
Navigate to /login.

screens.name: Company Onboarding
screens.purpose: Guide new users through creating first project, uploading document, and creating first template.

interactions.action: For each step, render appropriate form: project create (POST /api/projects), upload (POST /api/documents), template create (POST /api/templates), run extraction (poll /api/documents/:id). Upon completion, redirect to /app.

screens.name: User Dashboard
screens.purpose: Company overview: projects, recent activity, usage, and quick actions.

interactions.action: Switch current workspace in context, refetch dashboard data via /api/auth/me and relevant endpoints.
Navigate to /app/upload, preserving selected project if any.
Open new template modal or navigate to /app/templates/new (if implemented).
Navigate to /app/settings/api-keys.
Navigate to /app/projects/:projectId.
Navigate to /app/documents/:documentId.

screens.name: Project Folders
screens.purpose: Organize documents and templates into project folders.

components.title: Delete project?
components.description: This will not delete already processed documents, but will remove the folder organization.

interactions.action: Open project_create_modal.
POST /api/projects; on success, close modal and refresh projects_table.
Navigate to /app/projects/:projectId.
Open project_rename_modal prefilled with project data.
PUT /api/projects/:projectId; on success refresh table.
Open project_delete_modal; on confirm call DELETE /api/projects/:projectId and refresh.

screens.name: Project Detail
screens.purpose: View and manage documents and templates for a specific project.

interactions.action: Navigate to /app/upload?projectId=:projectId.
Navigate to /app/documents/:documentId.
POST /api/documents/:documentId/retry; show toast; update status via polling.
Navigate to /app/templates/new?projectId=:projectId.
Navigate to /app/templates/:templateId/edit.
POST /api/templates/:templateId/duplicate (if available) or handled client-side; redirect to edit new template.
Open confirm dialog; on confirm DELETE /api/templates/:templateId and refresh list.

screens.name: Document Upload Form
screens.purpose: Upload one or more documents for processing.

props.children: Upload PDFs, images, or scans up to 25 MB each.

fields.name: priority_flag
fields.label: High priority
fields.description: Send to the front of the processing queue where possible.

interactions.action: For each file, POST multipart to /api/documents with project_id, template_id, file; on success show toast and link to /app/projects/:projectId or first document's preview.
Navigate back to previous page or /app.

screens.name: Templates List
screens.purpose: View and manage all company templates (cross-project).

interactions.action: Navigate to /app/templates/new.
Navigate to /app/templates/:templateId/edit.

screens.name: Template Editor
screens.purpose: Create and edit extraction templates and field mappings with preview.

components.title: Fields
components.description: Define fields and map them to JSON keys.

components.title: Delete template?
components.description: Existing extraction results stay, but this template cannot be reused.

interactions.action: PUT /api/templates/:templateId with settings + field_schema; on success show success toast.
POST /api/templates/:templateId/test (or equivalent); then poll /api/documents/:id and render preview_json, preview_table, preview_logs.
Open delete_template_modal.
DELETE /api/templates/:templateId; on success redirect to /app/templates.
Append new field to field_schema and update fields_list.

screens.name: Extraction Preview
screens.purpose: View extraction results, status, logs, and export actions.

interactions.action: POST /api/documents/:documentId/retry; show toast; update document_info.status and refresh extraction_view on completion.
GET /api/documents/:documentId/export?format=json; trigger browser download.
GET /api/documents/:documentId/export?format=csv.
GET /api/documents/:documentId/export?format=excel.

screens.name: API Key Management
screens.purpose: Create, view, and revoke company API keys.

props.children: Use API keys to call DocFoundry from your apps and automation tools.

components.title: Create API key
components.description: Keys are scoped to this company. Store the secret value securely.

components.title: API key created
components.description: Copy this value now. You won’t be able to see it again.

interactions.action: Open create_api_key_modal.
POST /api/api-keys; on success show api_key_created_modal with plaintext_key and refresh api_keys_table.
POST /api/api-keys/:apiKeyId/revoke; on success mark status=revoked.
Copy plaintext_key to clipboard; show shadcn/Toast.

screens.name: Webhook Setup
screens.purpose: Configure webhooks to receive extraction results and other events with logs.

props.children: Get notified when documents finish processing or when key events happen.

interactions.action: POST /api/webhooks; on success show toast.
POST /api/webhooks/test with webhook_id; append to webhook_logs_table.
Open payload_modal populated with selected log payload.
POST /api/webhooks/:deliveryId/retry; update log row status.

screens.name: Integrations Guides
screens.purpose: Provide Zapier, Make, n8n, and REST API integration guides with examples.

props.children: Connect DocFoundry to Zapier, Make, n8n, or your own apps.

interactions.action: Swap visible markdown component; no API calls needed beyond static docs or MDX content.

screens.name: Usage & Billing
screens.purpose: Allow company owners to monitor usage and manage subscription plans.

interactions.action: GET /api/usage/summary and history endpoint; render line chart.
GET /api/billing/portal-session; redirect browser to Stripe customer portal URL.
GET /api/billing/checkout?plan=pro; redirect to Stripe Checkout.
GET /api/billing/portal-session preselect lower plan if supported; otherwise route to support instructions.

screens.name: Company Settings
screens.purpose: Manage company members, branding, and general settings.

components.title: Branding
components.description: Customize logo and primary color for this company.

interactions.action: PUT /api/workspaces/:id; show toast on success.
Open invite_member_modal.
POST /api/workspaces/:id/invitations; update members_table.
Open inline role select; PATCH /api/workspaces/:id/members/:memberId.
Confirm removal, then DELETE /api/workspaces/:id/members/:memberId and refresh.
PUT /api/workspaces/:id/branding; update workspace theme in UI context.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.purpose: Platform-level administration for multi-tenant monitoring and control.

interactions.action: POST /api/admin/impersonate/:workspaceId; set admin-impersonation token and redirect to /app as that owner.
PATCH /api/admin/workspaces/:id {status:'suspended'}; update row status.

screens.name: Notifications Center
screens.purpose: View in-app notifications such as usage thresholds, webhook failures, and billing issues.

interactions.action: Mark notification as read and navigate to related resource if link exists (e.g., /app/settings/usage-billing for usage_threshold_80).

screens.name: Not Found
screens.purpose: Display when a route or resource is not found.

components.title: Page not found
components.body: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist or you don’t have access.

interactions.action: Navigate to /app if authenticated, otherwise /login.
